mapper.insert: insert into account (username, password, email, status, login_fail_count, slider_required) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, 1, 0, 0)
mapper.select: select id, username, password, email, create_time as createTime, status, login_fail_count as loginFailCount, slider_required as sliderRequired from account where id = #{id}
select id, username, password, email, create_time as createTime, status, login_fail_count as loginFailCount, slider_required as sliderRequired from account where username = #{username}
select id, username, password, email, create_time as createTime, status, login_fail_count as loginFailCount, slider_required as sliderRequired from account where email = #{email}
mapper.update: update account set slider_required = case when login_fail_count + 1 >= 3 then 1 else slider_required end, login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update account set login_fail_count = 0, slider_required = 0 where id = #{id}
